2014-03-31
4.1.3
AUTOSAR
Release
Management
• Addition of the OS counters for deadline
monitoring
• Fixed data types for Supervised Entity
and Checkpoints (uint16)
• Several minor corrections throughout the
document
2013-10-31
4.1.2
AUTOSAR
Release
Management
• Minor fixes (mode switching,
dependencies to other modules)
• Quality corrections in the document
(e.g.formatting of requirements)
• Editorial changes
• Removed chapter(s) on change
documentation
2013-03-15
4.1.1
AUTOSAR
Administration
• Reworked according to the new
SWS_BSWGeneral
• New indexing scheme for requirements
• Clarification in Deadline Supervision
• Minor corrections in Specification of the
Ports and Port Interfaces
• Include file structure changed.
• Added a method to read after restart
which SE caused the reset:
WdgM_GetFirstExpiredSEID.
• New template with requirements
traceability
2011-12-22
4.0.3
AUTOSAR
Administration
• Streamlined the used terms
• Reorganized the structure of some
chapters
• Clarified ambigous statements and
resolved contradicting ones
• Corrected several bugs
• Provided more details what WdgM
functions do and in which sequence
▽
